text:
alex: Quick note for tomorrow's orientation 10am PT7: a few new hires in APAC say their calendar shows the wrong local time. Can someone check the event timezone and attachment?

riley: Looks like the original event was created in UTC. I'll change the event timezone to America/Los_Angeles and re-send.

sophie: Could we also paste the explicit start time in ISO in the description so clients that ignore timezone changes still see the correct wall-clock? e.g. 2026-08-02T10:00:00-07:00 (PT)

anya: Good idea. I'll update description with ISO time + direct Zoom link and passcode, and attach a fresh ICS. Also adding a short note: "If your calendar shows a different time, join at the PT start time above or DM us."

alex: Please include a fallback raw link (no query params) in case some clients strip the j/ link: https://zoom.us/w/2468013579

riley: Done. Description now has:

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/2468013579?pwd=onboarding123
Passcode: Welcome2026
Fallback: https://zoom.us/w/2468013579
Start (PT): 2026-08-02T10:00:00-07:00

sophie: Thanks! Can onboarding-bot confirm where the recording will go and retention? A few hires are traveling and will watch later.

onboarding-bot: Recording will be uploaded to s3://redwood-internal/onboarding-recordings and a link will be posted in #new-hires within 30 minutes after the session. Retention: 90 days.

anya: I'll pin the recording link to the event and post chapter timestamps in this thread after upload. Also sending a brief DM to APAC new hires to confirm their local time.

alex: Great. One more: for folks with corporate calendar auto-accept, remind them to "Add to calendar" manually so they get the updated ICS.

riley: Pinging everyone who RSVP'd yes with a timezone check now.

sophie: All good from me. If anyone still has issues tomorrow, reply here and I'll create a one-off invite in the correct TZ. :thumbsup:
